measured.method: imported dashboard.server the same way the container command does, then booted uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:57399 and issued 50 /health requests before sampling RSS

not_measured.worker: Worker requests/limits (500m/1Gi, limits 2Gi) are plausible defaults, NOT observations. memory.limits is a HARD cap: a build exceeding it is OOMKilled mid-run and the user sees the agent silently stop -- no error, no receipt.

why_recorded_this_way: A confident wrong sizing number is worse than an admitted unknown. Presenting an unmeasured worker limit as a recommendation would send an operator to production on a guess, and the failure mode is silent.
how_to_close_it: Run real builds and read `kubectl top pod -l app.kubernetes.io/component=worker --containers`, then set limits above the observed peak with headroom. Requires a live cluster and real builds.
